5g-nr-radio-architecture.titleEn: 5G Technical Deep Dive: 5G NR, OFDM, Massive MIMO, and Open RAN Fronthaul
5g-nr-radio-architecture.excerptEn: A technical breakdown of 5G New Radio: flexible numerology, OFDM waveforms, 3D beamforming, Massive MIMO channel state estimation, and Open RAN split 7.2x fronthaul.
5g-nr-radio-architecture.seoTitleEn: How Do 5G Networks Work Technically? 5G NR, OFDM, MIMO, and Fronthaul Explained
5g-nr-radio-architecture.metaDescEn: A technical guide to understanding what happens inside a 5G network: from 5G NR, OFDM, and Numerology to MIMO, Beamforming, fading, Fronthaul, and RU/DU/CU architecture, with 5G-Advanced and Release 19 updates.

ai-image-classification.titleEn: AI Image Classification: From Convolutional Neural Networks to Vision Transformers
ai-image-classification.excerptEn: Comprehensive technical deep dive into image classification: convolution operations, ResNet backbones, Vision Transformers (ViT), multimodal CLIP, and metric evaluation.
ai-image-classification.seoTitleEn: How Does AI Image Classification Work? From CNN to Vision Transformers
ai-image-classification.metaDescEn: A practical guide to understanding AI image classification: data preparation, CNN, ResNet, and Vision Transformers, Transfer Learning, the right metrics, CLIP and DINOv2, applications and challenges.

embedded-serial-protocols.titleEn: UART vs I2C vs SPI vs RS-232: Embedded Serial Communication Protocols Guide
embedded-serial-protocols.excerptEn: A practical engineering guide comparing UART, I2C, SPI, and RS-232/RS-485: wiring efficiency, clocking, signal integrity, and hardware decision matrices.
embedded-serial-protocols.seoTitleEn: UART vs I2C vs SPI vs RS-232: Choosing a Communication Protocol for Embedded Systems
embedded-serial-protocols.metaDescEn: A practical comparison of UART, I2C, SPI, and RS-232 in embedded systems: wiring, speed, synchronization, addressing, distance, voltage, errors, and the best use for each interface, with an I3C update.

smart-ai-ride-pooling.titleEn: Smart AI Ride-Pooling: Algorithms, Dynamic Routing, and Urban Congestion Reduction
smart-ai-ride-pooling.excerptEn: Algorithmic deep dive into on-demand shared ride-pooling: combinatorial request matching, dynamic vehicle routing (DARP), and balancing passenger detour times.
smart-ai-ride-pooling.seoTitleEn: How Does Smart AI Ride-Pooling Work? From Matching to Reducing Congestion
smart-ai-ride-pooling.metaDescEn: A guide explaining smart ride-pooling systems: the difference between Ride-Hailing and Ride-Pooling, real-time matching, demand prediction, GNNs and reinforcement learning, fleet rebalancing, and how to measure their real impact on congestion and emissions.

affective-computing.titleEn: Affective Computing: How Does AI Analyze Emotional Expression?
affective-computing.excerptEn: Affective Computing combines artificial intelligence, psychology, and human-computer interaction to detect expressive signals in the face, voice, text, and physiological signals, while retaining the bounds of uncertainty and context.
affective-computing.seoTitleEn: What Is Affective Computing? How Does AI Analyze Emotional Expression?
affective-computing.metaDescEn: A comprehensive guide to understanding Affective Computing: how AI systems analyze facial expressions, voice, text, and physiological signals, and what their applications, limitations, and ethical risks are.

digital-twin.titleEn: Digital Twin: What Is It, How Does It Work, and What Are Its Key Applications?
digital-twin.excerptEn: A Digital Twin is a data-based digital representation of a real-world entity or process, synchronized with reality to a degree and at a frequency suited to its intended purpose, for monitoring performance, testing scenarios, and supporting decisions.
digital-twin.seoTitleEn: What Is a Digital Twin? How It Works, Its Applications, and Its Main Challenges
digital-twin.metaDescEn: A comprehensive guide to understanding the Digital Twin: how it works, its components, the difference between it and simulation, and its key applications in industry, buildings, and healthcare, along with the challenges it faces.

facial-expression-recognition-ai.titleEn: How Does AI Recognize Facial Expressions? FER, FACS, and CNN Explained
facial-expression-recognition-ai.excerptEn: How do algorithms analyze the subtle movements of the facial muscles? A review of the FACS system and Action Units, the CNN and Vision Transformer architectures, and the challenges of lighting, angles, and ethics.
facial-expression-recognition-ai.seoTitleEn: How Does AI Recognize Facial Expressions? FER, FACS, and CNN Explained
facial-expression-recognition-ai.metaDescEn: A technical guide to understanding facial expression recognition with AI: from Face Detection, Landmarks, and FACS to CNN and the FER2013, CK+, AffectNet, and RAF-DB datasets, with bias, privacy, and the limits of emotion inference.

emotion-aware-recommendation.titleEn: Camera-Based Facial Expression Analysis and Content Personalization: How Do Emotion-Aware Recommendation Systems Work?
emotion-aware-recommendation.excerptEn: How computer vision is used to analyze facial expressions and movements and feed them into recommendation engines as a contextual probabilistic signal, while addressing the constraints of privacy, governance, and algorithmic bias.
emotion-aware-recommendation.seoTitleEn: Camera-Based Facial Expression Analysis and Content Personalization: How Do Emotion-Aware Recommendation Systems Work?
emotion-aware-recommendation.metaDescEn: A practical explanation of how facial expressions are analyzed via camera and used as a contextual signal in recommendation systems, from face detection and CNN to content personalization, with the key scientific limitations and the risks of privacy and bias.

internet-of-things-iot.titleEn: What Is the Internet of Things (IoT)? Architecture, Protocols, Applications, and Security
internet-of-things-iot.excerptEn: A comprehensive guide to understanding the Internet of Things: the layered architecture from sensors to the cloud, a practical comparison of MQTT, CoAP, and HTTP, LPWAN and Matter technologies, and security standards based on NISTIR 8259.
internet-of-things-iot.seoTitleEn: What Is the Internet of Things (IoT)? Architecture, Protocols, Applications, and Security
internet-of-things-iot.metaDescEn: A comprehensive guide to understanding the Internet of Things (IoT): how devices, sensors, connectivity, cloud, and edge work; the difference between Wi-Fi, BLE, Zigbee, LoRaWAN, NB-IoT, and LTE-M; MQTT and CoAP protocols; plus security, AIoT, and the future of 6G.

model-context-protocol-mcp.titleEn: Model Context Protocol (MCP): Standardizing AI Tool & Data Integration
model-context-protocol-mcp.excerptEn: Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that provides a unified way to connect AI applications and agents to tools, databases, and external resources, reducing custom integration code and strengthening security.
model-context-protocol-mcp.seoTitleEn: What Is the MCP Protocol? How Does It Connect AI Models to Tools and Data?
model-context-protocol-mcp.metaDescEn: A practical guide to understanding the Model Context Protocol (MCP): its architecture, tools, resources, and prompts, modern transports, security, and how it differs from APIs, Function Calling, and LangChain.

next-token-prediction.titleEn: Next Token Prediction: From N-grams to Transformers and Arabic LLMs
next-token-prediction.excerptEn: In-depth technical breakdown of next token prediction: from historical N-grams and LSTMs to causal self-attention Transformers, decoding heuristics, and Arabic morphology tokenization.
next-token-prediction.seoTitleEn: How Do AI Models Predict the Next Word? From N-gram to Transformers
next-token-prediction.metaDescEn: A practical explanation of how the next word or token is predicted in language models, from N-gram, RNN, and LSTM to Transformers, with generation strategies, the challenges of the Arabic language, and the Jais and ALLaM models.

5g-iot.titleEn: How 5G Transforms the Internet of Things: Speed, Latency, Massive IoT, and 5G-Advanced
5g-iot.excerptEn: A comprehensive guide to how 5G impacts IoT: when industrial and urban applications need eMBB, URLLC, and mMTC, and the role of RedCap, NB-IoT, and 3GPP standards up to 5G-Advanced.
5g-iot.seoTitleEn: How Do 5G Networks Affect the Internet of Things? Speed, Latency, Scale, and 5G-Advanced
5g-iot.metaDescEn: A guide explaining the relationship between 5G and the Internet of Things, from eMBB, URLLC, and mMTC to NB-IoT, LTE-M, and RedCap, with practical applications, security, the limits of theoretical figures, and the future of 5G-Advanced and 6G.
